items.html: But these Gevurot are sweeter and more mitigated than those Gevurot that were given in her through the spread of the Supernal Ima within her at the time of the deep sleep of ZA, as mentioned in the secret of the sawing. And the reason: at the time of the deep sleep of ZA, his soul, which is his mochin, ascended above, in Aba and Ima, in the aspect of Mayin Nukvin, and caused a supernal coupling in them; and by means of that coupling these Gevurot were sweetened and mitigated more than they were at first. And now he gives them to the Nukva by means of the Shofar blast.
